evidence.quote: WL 17 is a M3 protostar in the L1688 region of the $\rho$ Ophiuchus molecular cloud (cite: Doppmann2005), located a distance of 137 pc away (cite: OrtizLeon2017).

evidence.quote: whether it is a young protostar still embedded in its natal envelope, which has cleared out a hole despite its young age, or whether it is an older, disk-only source

findings_qualitative.value: WL 17 is likely a young source still embedded in a remnant envelope; the foreground extinction scenario fails to fit the SED.

evidence.quote: we suggest that WL 17 is a young source still embedded in the remnants of its natal envelope.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Class II disk with foreground extinction rejected due to poor SED fit and high required A_V

evidence.quote: our modeling cannot well distinguish between compact low mass envelopes and larger and more massive envelopes.
